generation: Use case: style-transfer. Production PNG RGBA sprite sheet for PipaKlub overworld. Image 1 (Kael sheet) is STRICT style/proportions/camera/reference ONLY; Image 2 is mother character identity ONLY. Generate ONLY the mother in Kael's small RPG chibi overworld style: oversized round head about 45% total body height, compact short body/legs, dark crisp pixel-aware contour, flat limited cel shading, warm tan skin, dark navy hair tied in bun, teal blouse, coral skirt, brown sandals. NO tall illustration proportions. Exactly 8 complete isolated sprites in a regular 4-column 2-row grid, equal cells, generous transparent padding and consistent foot baseline. Top row idle facing front/down, left, right, back/up. Bottom row one walking step facing front/down, left, right, back/up. Same identity/scale in all eight, stationary pivot; walking moves limbs not frame position. Orthographic RPG camera same as Kael. No item held, no text, no labels, no shadows on ground, no scenery, no glow, no Kael. Transparent background, preserve skirt/hair continuity. Output 1536x1024 if possible. Each sprite contained entirely within its cell.
